subject: Optimizer: Fix range extraction for CNF(conjunctive normal form) (#53908)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: planner range derivation now prefers a “best CNF item” range when it’s a proper subset of the column-only point/range result, improving selectivity for CNF-within-DNF shapes without narrowing beyond existing extracted ranges. `expression.Contains` was widened to match cloned expressions (by string) to make condition removal/dedup effective; upstream later refactors this to context-aware `Equal`, and no remaining Blocker/High correctness issues are evident in master history.
